title: Hunts FH-011T: Record the exact-SHA staging note for the legacy-path regression proof

source.ref: Split from FH-011S (2026-11-15): lib/hunts/legacy-regression.test.ts shipped and passes; the exact-SHA staging note is release engineering acceptance.

detail: Run lib/hunts/legacy-regression.test.ts and lib/hunts/legacy-paths.test.ts on the release SHA with every Hunt switch off, and write the staging note recording that SHA, the observability reading (commerce guard reports skipped, no [hunts-*] error) and the rollback result (switches on then off restores identical legacy results). Done when: the note exists with the SHA and links the passing run. Requires: FH-011S. Owner role: Release engineering.
